svg.title: October 18 evening Fed contract page checks
svg.desc: At 13:36 and 19:04 UTC October 18, Kalshi maintain-rate Chance headings were 87 and 87 percent; Kalshi 25-basis-point hike headings were 14 and 12 percent. Polymarket no-change named rows were 87 and 87 percent; its 25-basis-point increase rows were 14 and 14 percent. These are separate page observations, not quote times.
svg.text: Hold unchanged; Kalshi hike row −2 points
October 18, 2026 · two page checks, not continuous prices
